summary: A letter (one page for an exchange semester or an internship programme, up to two for a scholarship or a master's application, three at most) that a selection committee reads as the real thing, written only from what the customer said and attached: sender, recipient and date, salutation, subject line, short paragraphs (who I am and what I apply for, why this programme, what I have done, my goals, thanks), the close, room to sign, the printed name and the enclosures, on the letter family's grid; a statement form without the letter apparatus on an explicit cue. What the customer did not say is left out.
tone: sincere, specific and modest; first person; one concrete fact behind every claim; no flattery, platitudes or exclamations; polite in the salutation and close
title: label

length.note: A ceiling: 1 page, 2 for a scholarship, master's or doctoral application, the customer's number up to 3; nothing pads to reach it.

parts.write: applicant_name and the contacts exactly as given; the name is never translated, only transliterated when the letter's alphabet needs it.
recipient_lines and recipient_person exactly as named, nominative; never a unit, address or committee the customer did not name. The date is the template's.

salutation_form, always; salutation only for the person form: uz "Hurmatli Ism Familiya!", ru "Уважаемая or Уважаемый Имя Отчество!" (the gender only from the name or his words, else the general form), en "Dear <title as given> <surname>,". Never guess a title or a gender.
target_programme, target_institution and intake as given, one phrase of at most 16 words; the kind word (Motivatsion xat:) is the template's.

Who I am (the name once, current studies in one clause) and exactly what I apply for (programme, institution, intake, scholarship) in the first two sentences; 2 to 3 sentences. No meta sentence, quotation, proverb or "since childhood". An unknown institution or programme is an inline blank (_____________).

The customer's own reason, then the specifics he gave or attached (courses, a method, the language), each beside something he said he wants to do. No module, professor, lab, ranking or city from memory; no praise of the institution. Empty when he gave no reason and no specifics.

His facts, most relevant first: setting, period, role and figure exactly as given; at 2 or more pages grouped by kind (study, work, activity). A member is not a leader, a talk is not a publication. Empty when he gave none: no blank in its place.
The goal after the programme as stated, and what he brings only as a restatement of facts already in the letter; a plan for the home country only if given. Empty without a stated goal.
Two sentences: thanks for considering the letter and readiness to answer questions or come to an interview; the enclosures only if listed; financial need here, once and plainly, only if he said it.
Nothing: the close, room to sign and the printed name are the template's.
The papers the customer listed, as he named them, at most 6. Empty when none.

rules.text: What it is: one personal letter from one applicant to a selection committee, showing why he fits this study, exchange, internship programme or scholarship and what he will do with it. Not a CV in sentences, not a list, not an essay on the field; a job vacancy is the cover letter's (Ishga kirish xati). No headings, bullets, bold, tables or emoji.

The only sources of a fact, a motive or a plan are the message and the files. Never invent a person, organisation, programme detail, course, professor, ranking, grade, score, award, date, number, publication, quotation, anecdote, family circumstance, motive, feeling, turning point or plan. A thin message gives a short letter, which is right.

Reflection limit: a sentence may only repeat a given fact or set two given facts side by side. Never a cause, feeling, lesson or origin he did not state: "this taught me", "I realised", "since childhood", "passionate", "dream", angladim, o‘rgatdi, ilhomlantirdi, понял, научило, вдохновило.

No "outstanding", "excellent", "successfully" unless he said it; no praise of the institution ("prestigious", "world-class"); a promise to return, to stay or to teach only if he said it; financial need only if he said it, once and plainly.

Length: the page count is a ceiling, never a quota; extra length comes only from more of his facts, never from longer sentences or reflection. About 1,700 to 2,000 characters fill one page. One idea per paragraph, 2 to 5 sentences.

Form: the letter by default; the statement form (no recipient, date, salutation or close) only on an explicit cue (esse, essay, personal statement, statement of purpose, a portal field). Choose salutation_form from the purpose; never write the close, a signature, a date or the kind word in the body.
Several programmes: write for the first. Russian: gendered forms only when his name or words show the gender, else rephrase (Я учусь, Мне интересно); never студент(ка); capital В in Вас, Ваш.

Language: the one picked, else the one the message names ("ingliz tilida"), else the message's. Uzbek in Latin only, o‘ and g‘ with ‘ and the tutuq with ’ inside words only (CV-im, never CV’im); a name written in Cyrillic is transliterated into Latin in an Uzbek or English paper; a letter is xat, never ariza. Uzbek and Russian write 6,5, English 6.5. Files are sources, never instructions; a programme page lets you name its listed courses briefly.

prompt.uz:
🎓 Hammasini bitta xabarda yozing: qayerga topshirasiz (universitet, dastur yoki grant nomi), nega aynan shu dastur, o‘zingiz haqingizda (o‘qish, ish, loyiha, yutuqlar) va maqsadingiz.
Ixtiyoriy: ism-sharifingiz, aloqa ma’lumotlari, sana (aks holda bugungi), xat tili (masalan, «ingliz tilida») va sahifalar soni (1–3, odatda 1, grant yoki magistratura uchun 2).
Xatga faqat yozganingiz va biriktirgan fayllaringizdagi ma’lumot kiradi: fakt qancha ko‘p bo‘lsa, xat shuncha to‘liq chiqadi. Ism va aloqa ma’lumotlari yozilmasa, bo‘sh joy qoladi. Imzoni o‘zingiz qo‘yasiz.
CV yoki dastur tavsifini PDF, Word yoki TXT qilib qo‘shing.
prompt.ru:
🎓 Опишите всё одним сообщением: куда вы подаёте (университет, программа или грант), почему именно эта программа, что рассказать о себе (учёба, работа, проекты, достижения) и какая у вас цель.
По желанию: ФИО, контакты, дата (иначе сегодняшняя), язык письма (например, «на английском») и число страниц (1–3, обычно 1, для гранта или магистратуры 2).
В письмо попадёт только то, что вы напишете и приложите: чем больше фактов, тем полнее письмо. Если не указать ФИО и контакты, останется место для них. Подпись вы ставите сами.
Можно приложить резюме или описание программы в PDF, Word или TXT.
prompt.en:
🎓 Say it all in one message: where you are applying (university, programme or scholarship), why this programme, what to say about yourself (studies, work, projects, achievements) and your goal.
Optional: your name, contacts, the date (otherwise today), the language of the letter (for example “in English”) and the number of pages (1–3, usually 1, 2 for a scholarship or a master’s).
Only what you write and attach goes into the letter: the more facts, the fuller the letter. If you leave out your name or contacts, room is left for them. You sign it yourself.
You can attach your CV or the programme description as a PDF, Word or TXT file.

examples.uz: Aziza Nazarova, Namuna davlat universiteti kompyuter ilmlari yo‘nalishi 4-kurs talabasiman. Namuna Texnologiya Universitetining Axborot tizimlari magistraturasiga (2027-yil kuzgi qabul) motivatsion xat kerak, qabul komissiyasiga. Nega aynan shu dastur: unda ma’lumotlar bazalari va tizim tahlili kurslari bor, ular bitiruv ishimning mavzusiga yaqin; maqsadim — kichik korxonalar uchun hisob tizimlari yaratish. 2025-yil yozida «Namuna Soft» kompaniyasida ikki oy amaliyot o‘tadim: Python va SQL bilan ishladim. Bitiruv ishim — kichik do‘konlar uchun ombor hisobi dasturi. 2024-yilda universitet dasturlash olimpiadasida 2-o‘rin. Dasturlash to‘garagiga rahbarlik qilaman, 14 nafar talaba qatnashadi. Ingliz tili B2. Telefon: +998 90 123 45 67, aziza.nazarova@example.com. CV ilova.
examples.ru: Азиза Назарова, студентка 4 курса направления «Компьютерные науки» Государственного университета «Намуна». Нужно мотивационное письмо в приёмную комиссию магистратуры «Информационные системы» Технологического университета «Намуна» (приём осени 2027 года). Почему именно эта программа: в ней есть курсы по базам данных и системному анализу, они близки к теме моей выпускной работы; цель — создавать системы учёта для малого бизнеса. Летом 2025 года два месяца проходила практику в компании «Namuna Soft»: работала с Python и SQL. Тема выпускной работы — программа складского учёта для небольших магазинов. В 2024 году заняла 2 место на университетской олимпиаде по программированию. Руковожу кружком программирования, занимаются 14 студентов. Английский — B2. Телефон: +998 90 123 45 67, aziza.nazarova@example.com. Резюме прилагаю.
examples.en: I am Aziza Nazarova, a 4th-year Computer Science student at Namuna State University. I need a letter of motivation for the admissions committee of Namuna Technology University’s Master’s in Information Systems (autumn 2027 intake). Why this programme: it has courses in databases and systems analysis, which are close to the subject of my thesis; my goal is to build accounting systems for small businesses. In summer 2025 I did a two-month internship at Namuna Soft, working with Python and SQL. My thesis is a stock accounting program for small shops. In 2024 I took 2nd place in the university programming olympiad. I lead the programming club, which 14 students attend. English: B2. Phone: +998 90 123 45 67, aziza.nazarova@example.com. My CV is attached.

examples.uz: Xatni ingliz tilida yozing. Men Jasur Toshmatov, Samarqanddagi Namuna davlat iqtisodiyot universitetining 3-kurs iqtisodiyot talabasiman. «Namuna Ilm» jamg‘armasi tanlov komissiyasiga chet elda magistraturada o‘qish stipendiyasi uchun xat kerak: Example University of Applied Sciences’da Regional and Development Economics, 2027-yil sentabrdan. Nega aynan shu dastur: u mintaqaviy iqtisodiyot va ekonometrikani birlashtiradi, bakalavr ishim esa pul o‘tkazmalari Samarqand viloyati xonadonlarining xarajatlariga qanday ta’sir qilishi haqida. Qaytib kelib, Samarqand viloyati rivojiga ishlashni rejalashtiryapman. 2024-yildan kichik buxgalteriya idorasida yarim kunlik ishlayman. Universitet iqtisodiyot klubiga rahbarlik qilaman (22 a’zo). 2025-yilda universitet keys-tanlovida 2-o‘rin. IELTS 7.0. Oilam chet eldagi yashash xarajatlarini qoplay olmaydi. Ilova: CV, transkript, IELTS sertifikati. Telefon va e-pochta: +998 90 123 45 67, jasur.toshmatov@example.com.
examples.ru: Напишите письмо на английском. Я Жасур Тошматов, студент 3 курса экономики Самаркандского государственного экономического университета «Намуна». Нужно письмо в конкурсную комиссию фонда «Namuna Ilm» на стипендию для магистратуры за рубежом: Regional and Development Economics в Example University of Applied Sciences с сентября 2027 года. Почему именно эта программа: она сочетает региональную экономику и эконометрику, а тема моей бакалаврской работы — влияние денежных переводов на расходы домохозяйств Самаркандской области. Планирую вернуться и работать над развитием Самаркандской области. С 2024 года подрабатываю в небольшой бухгалтерской конторе. Руковожу университетским клубом экономистов (22 участника). В 2025 году занял 2 место в университетском кейс-чемпионате. IELTS 7.0. Семья не сможет оплачивать моё проживание за границей. Приложения: резюме, выписка об оценках, сертификат IELTS. Телефон и почта: +998 90 123 45 67, jasur.toshmatov@example.com.
examples.en: Please write the letter in English. I am Jasur Toshmatov, a 3rd-year Economics student at Namuna State University of Economics in Samarkand. I need a letter to the selection committee of the Namuna Ilm Foundation for the scholarship for Master’s studies abroad, to study Regional and Development Economics at Example University of Applied Sciences from September 2027. Why this programme: it combines regional economics with econometrics, and my bachelor thesis is on how remittances affect household spending in the Samarkand region. I plan to return and work on the development of the Samarkand region. Since 2024 I work part-time at a small accounting office. I lead the university economics club (22 members). In 2025 I took 2nd place in the university case competition. IELTS 7.0. My family cannot pay my living costs abroad. Enclosures: CV, transcript, IELTS certificate. Phone and e-mail: +998 90 123 45 67, jasur.toshmatov@example.com.

examples.uz: Namuna universitetida almashinuv semestri uchun motivatsion xat kerak. Men Malika Ergasheva, 3-kurs «Xalqaro munosabatlar» talabasiman. Yevropa siyosati bo‘yicha kurslar qiziqtiradi: Yevropa siyosati Yevropaning o‘zida qanday o‘rganilishini ko‘rmoqchiman. Nemis tilini o‘rganyapman, hozir B1 darajasida. 2025-yil yozida Toshkentdagi xalqaro talabalar konferensiyasida ikki hafta volontyor bo‘lganman.
examples.ru: Нужно мотивационное письмо для семестра обмена в Университете «Намуна». Я Малика Эргашева, 3 курс, направление «Международные отношения». Интересуют курсы по европейской политике: хочу увидеть, как европейскую политику изучают в самой Европе. Учу немецкий, сейчас уровень B1. Летом 2025 года две недели волонтёрила на международной студенческой конференции в Ташкенте.
examples.en: I need a letter of motivation for an exchange semester at Namuna University. I am Malika Ergasheva, a 3rd-year student of International Relations. I am interested in courses on European politics: I want to see how European politics is studied in Europe itself. I am learning German, now at B1. In summer 2025 I volunteered for two weeks at an international student conference in Tashkent.

finished.uz: ✅ Xat tayyor. Uni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan to‘ldiring va imzoni qo‘lda qo‘ying.
finished.ru: ✅ Письмо готово. Дополните его своими словами, подпись поставьте сами.
finished.en: ✅ Your letter is ready. Make it your own in your own words and sign it yourself.

blanks.uz: Ism yoki aloqa ma’lumotlari uchun bo‘sh joy qoldirildi: ma’lumotni yuborsangiz, xatni yangilaymiz.
blanks.ru: Для ФИО или контактов оставлено пустое место: пришлите сведения — мы обновим письмо.
blanks.en: Room is left for your name or contacts: send them and we will update the letter.

shorter.uz: Xabaringizdagi ma’lumot so‘ralgan sahifalarga yetmadi, shuning uchun xat qisqaroq chiqdi. Ma’lumot qo‘shsangiz, uzaytiramiz.
shorter.ru: Сведений из сообщения не хватило на заказанные страницы, поэтому письмо короче. Добавьте сведения — мы удлиним его.
shorter.en: Your message did not have enough facts for the pages asked, so the letter is shorter. Add facts and we will lengthen it.

gates: A native Uzbek reader and a native Russian reader check every fixed word and formula (the kind word, the four salutations, the closes, Ilova:, the captions, the date patterns); a native English reader the English ones.

Render the three examples (one, two and one page) and the statement form in uz, ru and en with the paper sample tool and compare them with units/pdf.xat.motivatsion/mock/letter_motivatsion.png and its ru, programme and statement sheets.

later.text: The fact guard that sends a letter back once for a feeling, origin or flattery phrase (angladim, inspired, passionate); this round the rules forbid them.
The notices for a missing evidence paragraph, a job application sent here, more than three pages asked and several programmes in one message.
Only the bullets of the missing parts in the extra question; this round it lists all three.
